Auditor
Visit the Auditor Department website to find information from their office.
Building Inspection
The Ottawa County Department of Building Inspection is responsible for the administration and enforcement of the applicable State of Ohio Building codes.
Clerk Of Courts
Community Improvement Corporation
Visit the Community Improvement Corporation website.
Coroner's Office
Ottawa County Coroner's Office
County Engineer
Learn more about Ottawa County's Engineer Department.
Court of Common Pleas
Visit the Ottawa County Court of Common Pleas website to review history, watch a live stream, review probation information, and more.
Dog Warden
Review dog warden contact information and browse dogs available for adoption.
Emergency Management Agency
The primary mission of the Emergency Management Agency is to save lives and protect property in the event of a man-made or natural disaster.
Erie / Ottawa Regional Airport
Take a trip through the Erie/Ottawa regional airport.
Fair Housing
Get information about fair housing in Ottawa County.
Family & Children First Council
Ottawa County Family and Children First Council is a partnership of local government, community members and families that enhances the well-being of Ottawa County’s children and families by building community capacity, coordinating systems and services, and engaging families.
Health Department
Job & Family Services
Employees of the Ottawa County Department of Job and Family Services are employed by the Board of County Commissioners to administer federally mandated programs within the county.
Juvenile Court
The Juvenile Court is committed to protect the rights and safety of our citizens, to work cooperatively with all community resources, and to improve the lives of children and families.
Municipal Court
It is the mission of the Ottawa County Municipal Court to guarantee fair and respectful treatment by providing an impartial, safe, efficient and accessible forum to resolve disputes so as to enhance public trust and community confidence in our court system.
Ohio State University Extension
Ohio State University Extension brings the knowledge of the university directly to Ottawa County.
Ottawa County Fair
The Ottawa County Fair is hosted to promote and encourage agricultural, domestic industry, science, industry, and other interests of Ottawa County with primary emphasis on developing the interest in and promoting programs of benefit to the youth of Ottawa County.
Ottawa County Parks District
Discover information about the Parks District events, classes, facilities, and more.
Ottawa County Transportation Agency (OCTA)
The Ottawa County Transportation Agency (OCTA) is a general public transit system that provides curb-to-curb, advanced reservation, shared ride service to anyone in Ottawa County who wants transportation for any reason.
Probate Court
The mission of the Ottawa County Probate is to provide efficient, fair, and quality services to the people of Ottawa County.
Prosecutor's Office
The Prosecutor's Office is committed to serving justice within Ottawa County.
Recorder’s Office
Review information from Ottawa County Recorder's Office or contact them for further details.
Recycle Program
The mission of the Ottawa, Sandusky, Seneca Joint Solid Waste Management District is to ensure quality waste stream management for its residents and to foster long term positive solid waste habits including recycling, reduction, reusing and buying of recycled products.
Regional Planning Commission
The Commission’s primary duty is to regulate the subdivision of land in the unincorporated areas of Ottawa County.
Riverview Healthcare Campus
Browse services and amenities available at Riverview Healthcare Campus in Ottawa County.
Sanitary Engineer
The Sanitary Engineer is responsible for the enforcement of all rules and regulations established by the Board of County Commissioners for the construction, operation, maintenance, protection and use of public water supply and wastewater infrastructure throughout Ottawa County.
Senior Resources
Ottawa County Senior Resources is your major resource of Senior Services for Ottawa County Seniors, their families, and caregivers.
Sheriff's Office
Visit the Sherriff's Office website to find contact and other information.
Soil & Water Conservation
Visit the Ottawa County Soil and Water Conservation District website to learn more about water and soil conservation in Ottawa County.
Transportation Improvement District
Browse information about the Ottawa County Transportation Improvement District.
Treasurer’s Office
The Ottawa County Treasurer is responsible for collecting real estate, manufactured home, and personal property taxes.
Veterans Service
The mission of the Ottawa County Veterans Service Commission is to ensure and preserve the basic, human and constitutional rights and maintenance of the services, benefits, and entitlements due to any veterans.
Visitors Bureau
Learn more about different places and attractions you can visit locally.
